create_patterns.name: selection-nothing-loaded-for-rinse-paraphrase
create_patterns.content:
# Nothing loaded for 'rinse' (clean paraphrase)
Task: 'Rinse a cloth and place it behind the sink.' Truth: pick_clean_then_place. Nothing was loaded. The description keys on 'clean/wash', so 'rinse' was not matched.
Fix: list rinse, scrub, and wipe as clean triggers.

create_patterns.name: selection-nothing-loaded-for-microwave-as-source
create_patterns.content:
# Nothing loaded when microwave is only implied heating
Task: 'Put mug in out the microwave going back to the coffee maker.' Truth: pick_heat_then_place. Nothing was loaded. The task has no heat/hot/cook word and the garbled phrasing hides the heating step. The heat description also warns 'Not for clean X in the microwave', which may make the selector cautious.
Fix: say that using the microwave means heat.

create_patterns.name: selection-nothing-loaded-even-with-exact-example-match
create_patterns.content:
# Nothing loaded even when the task matches an example
Traces: 'Move the keys from the desk to the safe', 'Put a cloth in the drawer', 'Put a bottle in a waste basket', 'take the candle from the sink to the toilet'. Truth: pick_and_place. Nothing was loaded each time, although the description says ALWAYS load and gives near-identical examples. Wording like 'ALWAYS' and 'Don't load nothing' did not change the behavior. Plain moves look too trivial to need a skill. Mentions of sink or toilet as places did not trigger clean.
Fix: state that every put/move/take task needs a procedure skill, and make this the default when no other trigger applies.

create_patterns.name: selection-nothing-loaded-for-two-with-exact-example
create_patterns.content:
# Nothing loaded for 'Put two compact disks in the safe'
Truth: pick_two_obj_and_place. Nothing was loaded although 'two' is explicit and the examples are close ('two sets of keys in the safe'). The selector skips loading even for clear keyword matches. This is a loading-behavior failure, not a description-ambiguity failure.

create_patterns.name: selection-examine-with-lamp-loaded-look-at-but-truth-pick-and-place
create_patterns.content:
# 'examine the statue with the lamp' loaded look_at_obj_in_light, but truth was pick_and_place
The look_at description lists this exact task as its example, so the selector loaded it. The label here was pick_and_place, so the example conflicts with the ground truth. Treat lamp-task labels as noisy and do not trust the example wording. Related: selection-lamp-examine-task-labeled-pick-and-place.
